config_version_history.status: SUPERSEDED - declared OPEN after phase3_heldout run found a real defect (docs/v2/PHASE3_STATUS.md): ClinicalTrialsSearchArgs.status/phase were typed Optional[str] with a custom field_validator, so .model_json_schema() emitted no `enum` for Cerebras and the model could (and did, case CT-008) guess a non-canonical phase/status value ('Phase 4') that was correctly rejected with no fallback, missing a required clinical_trials source on held-out.

config_version_history.note: Fix for the config_version 1 defect: orchestration/models.py's ClinicalTrialsSearchArgs.status/phase changed from Optional[str] + field_validator to Optional[Literal[tuple(sorted(VALID_TRIAL_STATUSES/PHASES))]] (derived from tools/clinical_trials_tool.py's own sets, never hand-typed), so .model_json_schema() now emits a real `enum` array for both fields in the tool declaration orchestration/candidate_b_native_tools.py sends to Cerebras. The old field_validators were kept for defense-in-depth (empirically redundant - pydantic's own Literal coercion now rejects out-of-set values first, at the type-coercion level, before the custom validator runs). Regression-verified (not a fresh held-out check - directive Step 33 forbids reusing the spent phase3_heldout split) against the same development+validation 59-case split: schema_valid_rate 0.9140 -> 1.0000, schema_invalid_count 8 -> 0, all 8 of which were clinical_trials phase/status format mismatches in the original run and 0 in this one; clinical_trials required-source miss rate stayed 0.0 -> 0.0 (was already passing on this split - the miss only showed up on the held-out split). Full numbers: artifacts/v2/phase3_candidate_b_regression_after_fix.json, docs/v2/PHASE3_CANDIDATE_B_FIX_REGRESSION.md. phase3_heldout and artifacts/v2/phase3_heldout_results.json were NOT touched or re-run by this fix. A fresh held-out supplement (new cases, not reusing the spent 15) is still required before Phase 3 can close - see docs/v2/PHASE3_STATUS.md.
